structuredContent.body:
Adds pure, currently unwired member-name value primitives for Refs #3720: fixed trim/UTF-16 validation, detached payload snapshots, explicit canonical UTF-8 bytes, deterministic epoch/order comparisons, and explicit clock/skew arithmetic. No existing protocol or runtime flow changes.

Exact source `13844778782e87f33608fcf86619a217d6803f8c` validation:

- 126/126 tests, full TypeScript check, targeted ESLint and base-to-head diff check passed.
- Thirteen safeguard mutants failed on assertions; byte-restored source passed 126/126 again.
- Eleven canonical byte/SHA vectors and ten string cases match immutable contract objects, independently reproduced in Python and by QA. Product code neither computes nor verifies hashes.
- [Independent exact-source QA](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/blob/2a85de28fd56058ee21acc1b2761043c9803b682/docs/qa-transfer/2026-11-20/reports/3720-name-primitives-138447787-review.md) and [immutable evidence](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/tree/34b85c945c31692a7692a8c6668e5518baae045a/docs/implementation-notes/3720-name-primitives) retain 34 seals, 24 actual receipts and the original failures.

The original first red label actually records a Vite fixture-transform failure before API import, not a product defect; its raw result is retained. The corrected loader then reached the absent-module red (zero tests). The initial untracked 122-test run and intermediate 125-test run remain historical only.

Payloads are detached, not frozen; byte arrays are fresh and mutable. IDs, hashes, epochs and stamps confer no authority. Primitives require lowercase fingerprints; future callers must handle that requirement explicitly at a reviewed boundary while the existing case-insensitive legacy codec remains unchanged. No record-ID verification, store, negotiation/transport, admission/grants, display resolver, mixed-version, readiness, live or release acceptance is claimed. Hosted exact-head CI remains required.
